interactive_components_rules.buttons: Always explicitly define background, hover, active, and text contrast. Example: bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 active:bg-emerald-800 text-white shadow-md hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-200
interactive_components_rules.inputs: Border rounded-lg px-4 py-2 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 focus:border-emerald-500 outline-none bg-white text-slate-900 placeholder:text-slate-400
interactive_components_rules.cards: bg-white border border-slate-200/80 rounded-2xl p-4 sm:p-5 hover:border-emerald-400 hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300 relative group overflow-hidden
interactive_components_rules.modals_and_drawers: Must use Shadcn Dialog / Sheet / Drawer components with backdrop-blur-md overlay (bg-slate-900/50)
interactive_components_rules.toasts: Use Sonner for cart additions, order confirmation, address updates, and alert notifications

testing_attributes.rule: Every interactive button, link, search input, filter item, cart counter, and main layout container MUST include a unique kebab-case data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a fully responsive, pixel-perfect, mobile-first Algeria e-commerce parapharmacy application named Pharma360.
Strictly follow the mint green and crisp white color palette with slate-dark typography.
Ensure all prices are displayed in Dinar Algérien ('DA' or 'DZA') with proper thousands separator (ex: 2 450 DA).

Implement full functional features: Fixed Header, Top Reassurance Banner, Category Navigation Menu, Live Auto-Suggest Search, Product Cards with strikethrough prices, Cart Drawer/Page with quantity manager, Checkout flow supporting both Payment on Delivery (COD) and Algerian Cards (CIB / Edahabia simulation), Customer account section with order history, Category filters & sorting, Individual Brand Pages, Blog & advice articles, Contact form with interactive Algier location map, and a robust Admin Back-Office dashboard for inventory & order management.
Add data-testid to every interactive component for automated test compliance.
Use lucide-react icons and sonner toast notifications.
